title: Brief: fence the check command so a backtick or newline renders

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S126 later note A2: BuildBrief embeds the project's CheckCommand in a single-backtick span (internal/engine/brief.go:81). A command with a backtick or a newline renders badly in the implementer brief.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestBriefFencesCheckCommandWithBackticks: a command containing backticks and a newline is fenced with a run longer than its longest backtick run.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Use a code fence one backtick longer than the longest backtick run in the command (CommonMark), or an indented block for multi-line commands.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
